subset.rationale: absl::Duration and absl::Time are concrete value types bound DIRECTLY: their arithmetic/comparison operators map to Python dunders and operator<<(std::ostream&,...) is surfaced as __str__ (e.g. str(Seconds(90)) == '1m30s'). They have no public integer constructors, so a timetest fixture namespace supplies the real factory/conversion free functions (absl::Seconds/Minutes/Hours/Milliseconds, ToInt64Seconds/..., FromUnixSeconds/ToUnixSeconds) to construct/extract values from Python. Differentially checked vs native Abseil. Exercises the cctz link closure (CoreFoundation).
skipped_features: absl::CivilDay/CivilSecond/... (civil_time<tag> specializations bind under mangled underlying-spec names; deferred for a clean-naming pass)
Duration/Time factory + conversion functions are exercised via timetest wrappers (absl::Seconds etc. are overloaded free functions, not directly namable as a single reflected entity)
